name: Cutoff card explains 10 April 2026 and loads its example

planSteps.description: Navigate to /ees?today=2026-10-19&fresh=1 and scroll to the card titled 'Why stays before 2026-04-10 are not compared' (data-testid=cutoff-explainer)
The rule text (data-testid=cutoff-rule) mentions 10 April 2026 and says days from earlier stays are not an EES error
The card shows two examples (data-testid=cutoff-example): the first reads 20 days left out and 0 compared, the second 20 days left out and 10 compared
In the second example ('1 to 20 March and 15 to 24 April 2026, EES says 10') click 'Load this history'
The URL contains scenario=cutoff-mixed, the scenario banner is shown and the date chip (data-testid=ees-on) reads 2026-05-01
Enter 10 in the EES days used field (data-testid=ees-days-used) and click compare (data-testid=ees-compare)

Your trips shows 30 days used, the findings list (data-testid=ees-codes) has data-codes exactly 'ees-ignores-pre-cutoff-stay', and the cutoff note (data-testid=ees-cutoff-note) has data-days 20 and says 10 days are comparable with the EES
